open_findings.title: Missed departure observation leaves short-play note available to label a later independent play
reproduction: Real HubCore onboarded 200 tracks of 180 s; app observes initial song, then arrival of T after a skip at progress 1 s, recording fresh lane note.
T is skipped after 6 s total so FakeSpotify does not list T. Another song plays 60 s without app player look. Cached snapshot remains T.
Controlled replacement deck fixture changes T reason to favorite and writtenAt, preserving track/order. Invoke actual HubCore.saveDeck so closeLaneNotes executes; restart HubCore over same sqlite.
Spotify plays T again in same playlist for 45 s entirely between app looks; skip, force real HubCore sync. Spotify listing creates one counted T history row.
open_findings.expected: The later occurrence has no proven link to the short earlier arrival. Return null for its lane rather than asserting fresh or inferring favorite from current deck. Retain observed paused long-occurrence lane where a matching occurrence is established.
open_findings.cause: closeLaneNotes compares only track id to cached player and exempts T even when snapshot is stale. Next closing look sets goneAt to now, so the listing ending before now passes the stamp bound and consumes old note. Missing intermediate look defeats occurrence binding.
open_findings.impact: False reason-of-play label in persisted History; no demonstrated changed queue/count/transport effect.
open_findings.repair_direction: Fence lane note consumption to the actual observed occurrence and provenance; ambiguous unobserved departures/repeats must yield null. Do not use wall time alone to fabricate completion or close genuine paused occurrence.
required_checks: Original paused same-occurrence across long pause/replacement
Listing dedup/count, read-only history, native/private/guest and stable queue regressions
open_findings.limits: Controlled deck publication fixture invokes real persistence/closure logic; no claim this exact replacement was reproduced through public rebuild workflow or live Spotify. FakeSpotify is simulation, not live latency/quota evidence.
